# Foundations

Production components and interface patterns for the World Series, race entries and training portal.

- Use the active site tokens: red for the primary action, black surfaces, white text and square action shapes.
- Anton sets display headings, Barlow sets readable interface copy, and Share Tech Mono sets supporting numbers.
- Keep decorative race typography away from long form labels and body copy. Preserve visible focus and clear input labels.
- Website fixtures use local fictional data. Embedded training screens retain their service-owned identity and authorization.
- The shared training inventory is a source reference. It does not claim that account-connected modules were executed in these previews.

## Accessibility and behavior

Use semantic controls, visible keyboard focus, persistent labels and accessible names for icon actions. Test both appearances, reduced motion and touch targets. Destructive actions retain their semantic color when a brand changes. Disabled and busy states must remain distinguishable. The previews show browser rendering; validate native layout and interaction separately.

## Branding and maintenance

Read tokens and styles from the production theme in config/style-guide.ts. Keep brand values out of component fixtures. Add isolated .story.stx variants for normal, disabled, busy, empty, error and boundary states where applicable. Use local fictional data; never import account stores or call services from a story. Regenerate with buddy docs:style-guide. Verify freshness with buddy docs:style-guide:check.
